game.title: Gears of War: E-Day
game.blurb: Third-person shooter set fourteen years before Gears of War, as the Locust Horde emerges, from The Coalition, released 2026-10-06. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign

chapters.title: Campaign Collectibles and Side Objectives

chapters.title: Horde Siege
chapters.summary: Missions, Invasion Events, the Supply Cache, classes, gadgets and weapon mods in Horde Siege.

chapters.title: Versus Multiplayer

chapters.title: Player Level and Re-Up

chapters.title: Combat and Teamwork
chapters.summary: Revives, saving players from Locust struggles and detached turrets.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "gears-of-war-e-day" (id 983213, released 2026-10-06, The Coalition, published by Xbox Game Studios), is the right game. No StrategyWiki page under "Gears of War: E-Day" or "Gears of War E-Day". gearsofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "Gears of War: E-Day", with at least 500 linked pages (the API's one-page limit; more remain), including "Kalona", "Emergence Day", "Hard Case", "Conquest", "Demolition" and "List of Achievements in Gears of War: E-Day"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 3010850 is "Gears of War: E-Day". 22 of 55 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the campaign chapter as a placeholder. Thirteen of them fall from 82% ("Emergence Begins") to 32% ("Nothing Left but the Fight") and look like campaign steps. "Dead Serious" (100% Insane campaign, 25,000 Versus kills, max level and classes) is placed in Player Level and Re-Up. Horde Siege and Versus need online play; several goals show 0.0% unlocked, as the game came out on 2026-10-06.
